summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 gap closure execution (plan 23-08: WinFsp extraction), run a security review on the Rust SDK crates, fix the identified issues, and increase test coverage before merging to a PR.
summary.outcome: Phase 23 fully closed with all 8 plans complete; security review identified 2 HIGH and 4 MEDIUM issues with the HIGH issues fixed immediately; 168 unit tests added across crypto/core/sdk crates; PR #352 created, merged with main, and pushed.

repo: Phase 23 introduced 5 new Rust crates (cipherbox-crypto, cipherbox-core, cipherbox-fuse, cipherbox-sdk, cipherbox-fuse-winfsp) extracted from the desktop app — the Rust workspace lives at the repo root.
CI collects Rust coverage via `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` on Linux; any tests added to workspace crates are automatically included.
The `ed25519-dalek` workspace dependency was missing the `zeroize` feature flag, meaning `SigningKey` was not zeroing on drop.

`generate_ed25519_keypair` callers in both macOS/Linux and Windows write_ops were wrapping the return value in a redundant `Zeroizing::new()` — indicating the API contract was not clearly communicated.
`fetch_and_populate_folder` and `resolve_file_pointers_blocking` existed as dead code in both platform paths (macOS/Linux operations.rs and Windows operations.rs) with no external callers.
`.release-please-manifest.json` tracks per-crate versions; merging from main required adding the 5 new Rust crate entries while preserving main's v0.27.0 versions for existing packages.
The project uses 1Password SSH agent for commit signing; it is intermittently unresponsive and requires retry attempts.

code.finding: `generate_ed25519_keypair` previously returned bare `Vec<u8>` for the private key; changed to `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` so private key material is zeroed on drop.
Caller wrapped `generate_ed25519_keypair` result in redundant `Zeroizing::new(...clone())` — simplified after return type change.
`ipns_private_key.try_into()` consumes a `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>`; needed `.into_inner().try_into()` since `Zeroizing` doesn't implement `TryInto<[u8; 32]>` directly.
Same `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>.try_into()` pattern as macOS path — required `.into_inner().try_into()` fix.
`fetch_and_populate_folder` and its only caller `resolve_file_pointers_blocking` were dead code — removed ~181 lines from both platform paths.
Added `zeroize` feature to `ed25519-dalek` workspace dependency to enable automatic key zeroing on drop.

workflow: When a GSD subagent disconnects mid-execution, spot-checking git log for commits and verifying acceptance criteria manually is the correct recovery path before recreating the summary/state artifacts.
Parallel agent spawning for independent test-writing tasks (one agent per crate) is effective — all three completed independently and results merged cleanly.
Security reviews should be committed into the repo (`.planning/security/`) and included in the PR, not left as ephemeral artifacts.
Dead code removal should be done immediately when identified during a security/quality pass rather than deferred to a separate PR.

friction: 1Password SSH agent failed to sign commits on 3 consecutive attempts, requiring the user to manually retry after being AFK — blocked progress for several minutes.
GSD subagent disconnected mid-execution (ConnectionRefused API error) during Wave 1, requiring manual recovery to complete the bookkeeping phase of plan 23-08.
`Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` does not implement `TryInto<[u8; 32]>`, requiring `.into_inner()` unwrapping — this is a non-obvious API gap that affected two separate platform files.
open_items: AES-CTR content integrity: client does not verify IPFS CID after fetching bytes, relying solely on the CID for integrity — a relay attacker could serve tampered ciphertext with predictable bit-flip impact (HIGH finding left unresolved).

`file_ipns_private_key` in `crates/fuse/src/write_ops.rs` (~line 174) uses `ed25519_dalek` directly via `SigningKey::to_bytes().to_vec()` rather than `generate_ed25519_keypair` — private key bytes not wrapped in `Zeroizing`, noted as out-of-scope for this session.
Medium findings from security review (4 items) were documented but not addressed — see `.planning/security/REVIEW-2026-03-24-phase23.md` for full details.
No unit tests were added for the `cipherbox-fuse` crate (FUSE operations, platform abstraction) — coverage there remains near zero.
Codecov comment (#4118656558) on PR #352 triggered test additions; coverage increase will be visible once CI runs on the updated branch.
